# Vendored Mermaid

- Version: 11.17.2 (standalone browser bundle)
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.17.2/dist/mermaid.min.js
- SHA-256: `581ed7d74bd9048d0e3a91363927d72ef22942d7722546b27f7cc29e35390eb8`
- License: MIT; see `mermaid-LICENSE.txt`. Bundled dependency notices are retained in the JavaScript.

include, retain license notices, and run the browser rendering tests.
